from fastapi import FastAPI, Depends, HTTPException, status
from fastapi.security import OAuth2PasswordBearer
import redis.asyncio as redis

app = FastAPI(title="NexusAI Fast Core")
cache = redis.from_url("redis://localhost:6379")

@app.get("/api/v1/inference")
async def generate_response(query: str, token: str = Depends(OAuth2PasswordBearer(tokenUrl="token"))):
    cached_result = await cache.get(f"query:{query}")
    if cached_result:
        return {"source": "cache", "payload": cached_result.decode("utf-8")}
    
    # Process through Nexus Neural Engine...
    result = {"status": "success", "tokens": 128, "model": "nexus-4-omni"}
    await cache.setex(f"query:{query}", 3600, str(result))
    return result
